item.title: Global Gateways Meet & Greet in Bloomington — Thu Jul 23, 5:00 PM — STEPHEN L. & CONNIE J. FERGUSON INTERNATIONAL CENTER
item.description: You are cordially invited to our Meet & Greet with IU's Global Gateways (https://global.iu.edu/presence/gateways/index.html) on Thursday, July 23 from 5 pm. Whether you have worked with one of the Gateways before or have been meaning to find out more about Gateways, we'd love to welcome you to an afternoon at IU Bloomington Ferguson International Center, 421-423! The event will start out with a brief overview of IU's five Global Gateways and how they serve IU faculty, students, and alumni. There will be plenty of time for general questions about the Gateway network as well as opportunities to meet local team members from the ASEAN, Ghana, India, Europe and Mexico Gateways who will be present at the event.ASEAN GatewayWanlaya (Koi) PittayapitakProgram Manager Ghana GatewayAbigail Opong-TettehProgram Manager India GatewayZafeena Suresh Director Minu Thomas Program Manager Europe GatewayAnnabell

item.title: New Exhibitions pARTy — Sat Aug 8, 2:30 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description:
New Exhibitions pARTy Celebrate summer with the Brown County Art Guild at our New Exhibitions pARTy! Explore new artwork by our Guild Artist Members in the Guild Artist Exhibition & Sale, along with their special exhibition, The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views, showcasing the beauty, landscapes, and iconic scenes of Brown County. Guests can also view the exceptional historic exhibition, T.C. Steele Memorial Exhibition, honoring one of Indiana’s most beloved artists. Enjoy an afternoon of art, music, meet the artists, and enjoy complimentary refreshments as we celebrate creativity at the Guild.
Source: Brown County Art Guild
